title: Machine learning nominates an MT2A-S100A8 axis in pulmonary fibrosis
summary: SHAP-interpreted LASSO nominated MT2A and in silico knockout nominated S100A8 as its downstream target. Co-immunoprecipitation recovered both proteins in one complex and surface plasmon resonance measured direct binding with an apparent Kd of 88 +/- 20 nM. In epithelial cells, MT2A knockdown reduced S100A8 and reversed the EMT signature, and S100A8 re-expression restored EMT. AI screening only nominated BRD-K54403101 as a candidate MT2A binder; evidence is from cells and a bleomycin mouse model.
ai_technology: SHAP-interpreted LASSO across five transcriptomic cohorts and single-cell virtual gene knockout to nominate MT2A and S100A8, plus AI-guided drug screening

evidence.tested: Co-IP, SPR, mouse model and loss/gain-of-function with rescue in BEAS-2B cells.
evidence.unknown: Human relevance; binder candidate untested; machine learning used is modest; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: SHAP-interpreted LASSO and single-cell virtual knockout for target nomination
